# Kubai 087（枯白啃设计）

Kubai 087 (Chinese name 枯白啃设计, handle kubai087) is an app icon designer who also builds their own products. The best known is Lumno, an open-source browser command bar and minimalist new tab for Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

## Work

- Lumno: open-source browser command bar (tab, bookmark, history and site search) and minimalist new tab. Site: https://lumno.kubai.design/ (English: https://lumno.kubai.design/en/). Source: https://github.com/kubai087/lumno-extension
- App icon work and icon design tutorials, in Chinese, on Xiaohongshu: https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/5f30130300000000010006eb
